payload.note: Axial-slice quadratic-coercivity checkpoint: for every periodic four-dimensional L^4 lattice with L>=4 and arbitrary transverse field, slice Jensen gives A(psi)>=L^3/2*||(Delta_1 b)_+||_2^2. A zero-sum positive-part Fourier lemma then proves A(psi)>=(N*omega_L^2/3)*|psi_hat(e_mu)|^2, equivalently S_lambda(phi)>=(N*omega_L^2/3)*|phi_hat(e_mu)|^2. This closes low-action escape of the selected coefficient at the correct free quadratic scale and improves the earlier correct-scale quartic bound; the known global bilaplacian quadratic envelope had an extra factor-N loss. It does not control normalized orthogonal cross-section entropy, the lowest-mode Gibbs moment, interacting H^-1, continuum reconstruction, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian gates. The next gate is the normalized center-hypersurface Jacobian/weight after combining this origin cost with the all-background fiber curvature theorem.
